content:
elena (finance): Quick company-wide note: on 2026-06-01 UTC were switching invoice attribution to per-minute reconciliation for short bursts. This is an attribution change only  prices unchanged.

diego (billing): Why this helps: current daily averaging masks short, expensive spikes. Per-minute attribution makes invoices reflect when tokens were actually consumed and helps us tune routing/fairness.

maya (ops): Important: runtime behavior for throttling stays conservative  well use a 60-minute lookback window for rate decisions to avoid oscillation. Dedicated clusters can opt into strict minute-aware policies if they want tighter fairness.

elena (finance): How credits are consumed: all free/promotional credits apply against the minute the usage occurs (first). This may make heavy short workloads exhaust credits faster than under the old smoothing. Were notifying affected accounts.

trent (support): Suggested short reply for customers: "Weve moved to minute-level usage attribution so sudden bursts may show as invoice spikes. We can review or temporarily re-enable legacy smoothing on request."

diego (billing): Engineering note: meter events will add `minute_bucket` and `burst_marker`. Export CSV will include `minute_bucket` (ISO minute), `tokens_used`, `route`, `model_id`, `usd_unit`. Example row: 1234,2026-06-01T15:42,5120,chat-completion/redwood-alpha,gptx-3q,0.00012

maya (ops): Data consumers: expect higher export row counts. Recommend partitioning by `minute_bucket` and TTL guidance in docs.

elena (finance): Enterprise/contracted customers: base commit math unchanged. If contract language requires legacy attribution, raise via @diego and Legal will triage exemptions.

diego (billing): Opt-out: 90-day UI/API toggle for legacy daily smoothing available at launch. After 2026-08-31 new opt-ins close; existing toggles remain until renewal.

metering-bot: release billing-meter v2.14 deployed at 2178003460  minute_bucket emission ENABLED.

trent (support): Ill add a troubleshooting playbook and sample queries to find minute spikes.

elena (finance): Rollout checklist: blog + help center article 2026-05-04, console banner 2026-05-09, customer emails 2026-05-11, telemetry review 2026-06-07. AMA scheduled in #announcements-support on 2026-05-14.

diego (billing): Questions/bugs: please file in #eng-releases and tag `billing-meter` + `prio:high` if a customer invoice looks materially different.

maya (ops): Link to internal runbook: https://redwood-internal.docs/runbooks/minute-reconcile (internal). Add notes if you see gaps.

elena (finance): Thanks team  closing the thread.
